packageRules.description: Match pnpm 11's 24-hour package-age policy so npm update PRs do not enter CI before frozen installs can accept them.
Lint/format toolchain (ESLint, Prettier, typescript-eslint and their plugins) — group into one PR; they're co-tuned and bump together.
Vitest core and its coverage provider are co-versioned — group them.
typescript-eslint does not support the TypeScript 7 compiler API yet.
